tool_args.rationale: The branch probe established gradient suppression but did not resolve whether it subtracts an outflow or attenuates the entire transfer. Both mechanisms fit the paid data well and diverge at low inflow and high gradient, making an additional trajectory batch more informative than confirming either model now.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fits the seven rows to about 0.004 RMSE, but the two off-baseline gradients were observed only at higher inflows, leaving low-inflow outflow weakly constrained.

considered_alternatives.option: Multiplicative gradient attenuation of a Hill saturation curve
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fits to about 0.003 RMSE but predicts 0.82 at u_now = 0.5 and s_grad = 2.3, versus 0.63 for the additive outflow model. That difference is more than four times the confirmation tolerance.
Does not distinguish how the gradient modifies transfer.
